## 🚀 New features and improvements

* Allow formatted markup for node descriptions (#6511) @mPokornyETM
* Hide potentially sensitive values (system properties and environment variables) by default (#6843) @daniel-beck
* [JENKINS-69339](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-69339) - Add support for badge icons in Management links (#6995) @mawinter69
* Add tabs to System Information page (#7373) @janfaracik
* [JENKINS-70169](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-70169) - Add missing breadcrumb items in `resources/hudson/model/Computer*` (#7495) @lemeurherve
* Restyle file uploads to fit in with modern forms UI (#7452) @janfaracik
* [JENKINS-70169](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-70169) - Add missing breadcrumb items in `resources/hudson/logging` (#7490) @lemeurherve
* [JENKINS-70169](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-70169) - Add missing breadcrumb items in `resources/hudson/model/Run` (#7491) @lemeurherve
* [JENKINS-70169](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-70169) - Add missing breadcrumb items in `resources/hudson/slaves` (#7488) @lemeurherve

## 🐛 Bug fixes

* [JENKINS-70103](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-70103) - `WeakHashMap` broken for looking up Jetty `Session` in WebSocket response (#7412) @jglick
* [JENKINS-70105](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-70105) - Slow down WebSocket reconnect logic when the controller is responding (#7407) @dependabot
* [JENKINS-70036](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-70036) - Weird animation artifacts in admin monitor popup (#7399) @benebsiny
* Synchronize agent protocol access (#7378) @basil

## 🌐 Localization and translation

* Address issues regarding Brazilian Portuguese translation and refactoring of Jelly/Properties files keys for `JNLPLauncher` related views (#7353) @glasswalk3r

## 👷 Changes for plugin developers

* Introduce a high-level HTTP client API (#7398) @basil

## 📦 Dependency updates

* [JENKINS-70105](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-70105) - Slow down WebSocket reconnect logic when the controller is responding (#7407) @dependabot
* Remove Commons HttpClient 3.x (#7312) @basil
* Upgrade Spring Framework from 5.3.23 to 5.3.24 (#7391) @dependabot

* Bump mina-sshd.version from 2.8.0 to 2.9.0 (#6903) @dependabot

## 📢  Java 8 end of life June 21 2022 in weekly release line

* Update date for dropping Java 8 support in weekly line (#6566) @timja

## 🚨 Removed

* [JENKINS-51820](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-51820) - Removing Java Web Start support (#6543) @jglick
* Revert [JENKINS-20679](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-20679) - (support for plugin Java requirement metadata) (#6549) @basil

## 🚀 New features and improvements

* Use `URLClassLoader` by default (#6571) @basil

* Suppress more stack traces from `DefaultJnlpSlaveReceiver.channelClosed` (#6555) @jglick

* [JENKINS-68381](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-68381) - allow to set id and style for l:icon with symbols (#6532) @mawinter69

* [JENKINS-68296](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-68296) - Restore actions icon lookup with size (#6556) @alecharp

## 👷 Changes for plugin developers

* Add color override classes (#6538) @janfaracik
* [JENKINS-68200](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-68200) - Winstone 5.25 - Bump Jetty from 9.4.45.v20220203 to 9.4.46.v20220331 (#6558) @MarkEWaite
* Revert [JENKINS-20679](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-20679) - (support for plugin Java requirement metadata) (#6549) @basil
* [JENKINS-68381](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-68381) - allow to set id and style for l:icon with symbols (#6532) @mawinter69

## 📦 Dependency updates

* Upgrade Spring Framework from 5.3.19 to 5.3.20 (#6565) @dependabot

## 🚨 Removed

* Remove `ui-refresh-overrides.less` and UI refresh toggle (#6470) @janfaracik
* Remove `html.jelly` in favor of `layout.jelly` (#6468) @janfaracik

## 🚀 New features and improvements

* [JENKINS-62024](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-62024) - Add quick filter box for dropdown lists in hetero-list (#4688) @johnlinp
* [JENKINS-68284](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-68284) - Modernise log recorder pages (#6473) @timja
* [JENKINS-61985](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-61985) - Support 'myView' with configuration as code (#6202) @timja
* Add dropdown to user cause trigger (#6276) @NotMyFault
* [JENKINS-68276](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-68276) - Upgrade bundled Jackson 2 API plugin from 2.12.0 to 2.13.2.20220328-273.v11d70a_b_a_1a_52 (#6480) @jtnord
* Upgrade Spring Framework from 5.3.18 to 5.3.19 (#6474) @dependabot
* Use the `jenkins-input` class in more locations (#6442) @NotMyFault
* Revert [JENKINS-24513](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-24513) - Add access control for builds admin monitor (#6222) @timja
* Add "copy to clipboard" button to the script console output (#6455) @NotMyFault
* Align shutdown banner, starvation and add a sidepanel to the plugin uninstallation view (#6457) @NotMyFault
* Use `f:dropdownDescriptorSelector` for agent launcher (#6464) @mawinter69

## 🐛 Bug fixes

* [JENKINS-68277](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-68277) - Fix not being able to disable a plugin when dependent plugins are disabled (#6486) @janfaracik
* [JENKINS-68129](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-68129) - Fix dropdown chevrons not separating links and overflowing (#6481) @janfaracik
* [JENKINS-51913](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-51913) - Prevent `archiveArtifacts` from displaying a stack trace when no artifacts are found (#6475) @gregswift
* [JENKINS-68270](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-68270) - Fix third party weather icons in table view (#6482) @NotMyFault
* [JENKINS-68103](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-68103) - Fix build progress bar not taking the user to console output (#6479) @janfaracik
* [JENKINS-67849](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-67849) - Correct icon resolution for remote icons (#6476) @timja
* [JENKINS-68260](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-68260) - Allow filtering updates by plugin ID (#6483) @zbynek

## 🚀 New features and improvements

* [JENKINS-66446](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-66446) - Adjust class loading behavior of `JnlpSlaveRestarterInstaller` (#6315) @jglick

## 👷 Changes for plugin developers

* Refactor `translation-tool.pl` (#6317) @glasswalk3r

* Bump Guava from 31.0.1 to 31.1 (#6322) @dependabot

## 🚀 New features and improvements

* feat: Add ability to upload a plugin via URL [JENKINS-4814](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-4814) - (#5862) @slide
* Improve artifact list readability in dark theme (#5889) @zbynek
* Bump `bouncycastle-api` from 2.20 to 2.25 (#5898) @basil
* Stop bundling unnecessary copy of ASM 5 (#5524) @basil
* Use CSS animation for console progress (#5871) @zbynek
* Modernise the 'New view' and 'New node' pages (#5842) @janfaracik
* Update spinner component across Jenkins (#5876) @janfaracik

## 🐛 Bug fixes

* Merge 2.319 security fixes back into master (#5880) @daniel-beck
* [JENKINS-66993](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-66993) - Do not register `AntClassLoader` as parallel-capable (#5865) @basil
* [JENKINS-67063](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-67063) - Revert canonicalization of entries when untarring (#5900) @daniel-beck
* Avoid false positives in plugin search (installed tab) (#5870) @zbynek
* Add a gap between icon and text in build links (#5887) @uhafner
* [JENKINS-67061](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-67061) - Fix overload in ConfigDirectory (#5881) @daniel-beck
* [JENKINS-66749](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-66749) - Missing spaces in upstream/downstream project view (#5850) @jamesD33064
* [JENKINS-67028](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-67028) - Fix missing project hyperlink in build history (#5875) @NotMyFault
* [JENKINS-67032](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-67032) - Address dead URLs (#5874) @NotMyFault
* [JENKINS-67002](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-67002) - protect Jenkins against bad RestartListeners (#5864) @jtnord
* [JENKINS-66845](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-66845) - Fix  "User Defined Time Zone" configuration field to correctly show corresponding user's timezone value #Hacktoberfest (#5801) @nom3ad

## 👷 Changes for plugin developers

* Stop bundling unnecessary copy of ASM 5 (#5524) @basil
* Unfork `AntClassLoader` (#5856) @basil

## 📦 Dependency updates

* Bump `bouncycastle-api` from 2.20 to 2.25 (#5898) @basil
* Stop bundling unnecessary copy of ASM 5 (#5524) @basil

## 🚀 New features and improvements

* [JENKINS-66714](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-66714) - Use reworked job logo in build queue (#5832) @benebsiny
* [JENKINS-61212](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-61212) - Fix Agent handshake when connecting them over Websocket on Java 11 + [JENKINS-64831](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-64831) - Remoting 4.11: Deprecate the -cp option in the agent.jar (#5821) @dependabot
* [JENKINS-49675](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-49675) - Mark the cookie as secure when serving via HTTPS (#5788) @jtnord
* Update messages.properties translation for Spanish (#5782) @Brick7Face

* [JENKINS-66854](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-66854) - `AsyncPeriodicWork` should not touch its log file unless it has something to say (#5802) @jglick
* [JENKINS-66753](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-66753) - Ongoing build disappears from build history (#5760) @janfaracik

* [JENKINS-61212](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-61212) - Fix Agent handshake when connecting them over Websocket on Java 11 + [JENKINS-64831](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-64831) - Remoting 4.11: Deprecate the -cp option in the agent.jar (#5821) @dependabot

## 🚀 New features and improvements

* Allow formatted markup for node descriptions (#6511) @mPokornyETM
* Hide potentially sensitive values (system properties and environment variables) by default (#6843) @daniel-beck
* [JENKINS-69339](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-69339) - Add support for badge icons in Management links (#6995) @mawinter69
* Add tabs to System Information page (#7373) @janfaracik
* [JENKINS-70169](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-70169) - Add missing breadcrumb items in `resources/hudson/model/Computer*` (#7495) @lemeurherve
* Restyle file uploads to fit in with modern forms UI (#7452) @janfaracik
* [JENKINS-70169](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-70169) - Add missing breadcrumb items in `resources/hudson/logging` (#7490) @lemeurherve
* [JENKINS-70169](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-70169) - Add missing breadcrumb items in `resources/hudson/model/Run` (#7491) @lemeurherve
* [JENKINS-70169](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-70169) - Add missing breadcrumb items in `resources/hudson/slaves` (#7488) @lemeurherve
* [JENKINS-70169](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-70169) - Add missing breadcrumb items in `resources/hudson/model/View` (#7493) @lemeurherve
* [JENKINS-70169](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-70169) - Add missing breadcrumb items in `resources/hudson/model/Abstract*` (#7494) @lemeurherve
* [JENKINS-70169](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-70169) - Add missing breadcrumb items in `resources/hudson/model/User` (#7492) @lemeurherve
* [JENKINS-70169](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-70169) - Add missing breadcrumb items in `resources/jenkins` (#7487) @lemeurherve
* Update the design of the 'Advanced' button (#7173) @janfaracik
* Upgrade XStream from 1.4.19 to 1.4.20 (#7548) @dependabot

## 🐛 Bug fixes

* [JENKINS-70128](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-70128) - Revert "Label destructive 'Dismiss' buttons red" (#7556) @NotMyFault
* [JENKINS-70112](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-70112) - Don't prompt the user that changes may not have been saved after apply clicked (#7555) @timja
* fix letter-spacing (#7475) @Gadzy
* [JENKINS-70117](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-70117) - Align is not same between th and td (#7425) @ridemountainpig

## 📦 Dependency updates

* Upgrade XStream from 1.4.19 to 1.4.20 (#7548) @dependabot

## 🌐 Localization and translation

* Address issues regarding Brazilian Portuguese translation and refactoring of Jelly/Properties files keys for `JNLPLauncher` related views (#7353) @glasswalk3r

* Introduce a high-level HTTP client API (#7398) @basil

* Bump mina-sshd.version from 2.8.0 to 2.9.0 (#6903) @dependabot

## 📢  Java 8 end of life June 21 2022 in weekly release line

* Update date for dropping Java 8 support in weekly line (#6566) @timja

## 🚨 Removed

* [JENKINS-51820](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-51820) - Removing Java Web Start support (#6543) @jglick
* Revert [JENKINS-20679](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-20679) - (support for plugin Java requirement metadata) (#6549) @basil

## 🚀 New features and improvements

* Use `URLClassLoader` by default (#6571) @basil

* Suppress more stack traces from `DefaultJnlpSlaveReceiver.channelClosed` (#6555) @jglick

* [JENKINS-68381](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-68381) - allow to set id and style for l:icon with symbols (#6532) @mawinter69

* [JENKINS-68296](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-68296) - Restore actions icon lookup with size (#6556) @alecharp

## 👷 Changes for plugin developers

* Add color override classes (#6538) @janfaracik
* [JENKINS-68200](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-68200) - Winstone 5.25 - Bump Jetty from 9.4.45.v20220203 to 9.4.46.v20220331 (#6558) @MarkEWaite
* Revert [JENKINS-20679](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-20679) - (support for plugin Java requirement metadata) (#6549) @basil
* [JENKINS-68381](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-68381) - allow to set id and style for l:icon with symbols (#6532) @mawinter69

## 📦 Dependency updates

* Upgrade Spring Framework from 5.3.19 to 5.3.20 (#6565) @dependabot

## 🚨 Removed

* Remove `ui-refresh-overrides.less` and UI refresh toggle (#6470) @janfaracik
* Remove `html.jelly` in favor of `layout.jelly` (#6468) @janfaracik

## 🚀 New features and improvements

* [JENKINS-62024](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-62024) - Add quick filter box for dropdown lists in hetero-list (#4688) @johnlinp
* [JENKINS-68284](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-68284) - Modernise log recorder pages (#6473) @timja
* [JENKINS-61985](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-61985) - Support 'myView' with configuration as code (#6202) @timja
* Add dropdown to user cause trigger (#6276) @NotMyFault
* [JENKINS-68276](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-68276) - Upgrade bundled Jackson 2 API plugin from 2.12.0 to 2.13.2.20220328-273.v11d70a_b_a_1a_52 (#6480) @jtnord
* Upgrade Spring Framework from 5.3.18 to 5.3.19 (#6474) @dependabot
* Use the `jenkins-input` class in more locations (#6442) @NotMyFault
* Revert [JENKINS-24513](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-24513) - Add access control for builds admin monitor (#6222) @timja
* Add "copy to clipboard" button to the script console output (#6455) @NotMyFault
* Align shutdown banner, starvation and add a sidepanel to the plugin uninstallation view (#6457) @NotMyFault
* Use `f:dropdownDescriptorSelector` for agent launcher (#6464) @mawinter69

## 🐛 Bug fixes

* [JENKINS-68277](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-68277) - Fix not being able to disable a plugin when dependent plugins are disabled (#6486) @janfaracik
* [JENKINS-68129](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-68129) - Fix dropdown chevrons not separating links and overflowing (#6481) @janfaracik
* [JENKINS-51913](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-51913) - Prevent `archiveArtifacts` from displaying a stack trace when no artifacts are found (#6475) @gregswift
* [JENKINS-68270](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-68270) - Fix third party weather icons in table view (#6482) @NotMyFault
* [JENKINS-68103](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-68103) - Fix build progress bar not taking the user to console output (#6479) @janfaracik
* [JENKINS-67849](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-67849) - Correct icon resolution for remote icons (#6476) @timja
* [JENKINS-68260](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-68260) - Allow filtering updates by plugin ID (#6483) @zbynek

## 🚀 New features and improvements

* [JENKINS-66446](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-66446) - Adjust class loading behavior of `JnlpSlaveRestarterInstaller` (#6315) @jglick

## 👷 Changes for plugin developers

* Refactor `translation-tool.pl` (#6317) @glasswalk3r

* Bump Guava from 31.0.1 to 31.1 (#6322) @dependabot

## 🚀 New features and improvements

* feat: Add ability to upload a plugin via URL [JENKINS-4814](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-4814) - (#5862) @slide
* Improve artifact list readability in dark theme (#5889) @zbynek
* Bump `bouncycastle-api` from 2.20 to 2.25 (#5898) @basil
* Stop bundling unnecessary copy of ASM 5 (#5524) @basil
* Use CSS animation for console progress (#5871) @zbynek
* Modernise the 'New view' and 'New node' pages (#5842) @janfaracik
* Update spinner component across Jenkins (#5876) @janfaracik

## 🐛 Bug fixes

* Merge 2.319 security fixes back into master (#5880) @daniel-beck
* [JENKINS-66993](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-66993) - Do not register `AntClassLoader` as parallel-capable (#5865) @basil
* [JENKINS-67063](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-67063) - Revert canonicalization of entries when untarring (#5900) @daniel-beck
* Avoid false positives in plugin search (installed tab) (#5870) @zbynek
* Add a gap between icon and text in build links (#5887) @uhafner
* [JENKINS-67061](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-67061) - Fix overload in ConfigDirectory (#5881) @daniel-beck
* [JENKINS-66749](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-66749) - Missing spaces in upstream/downstream project view (#5850) @jamesD33064
* [JENKINS-67028](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-67028) - Fix missing project hyperlink in build history (#5875) @NotMyFault
* [JENKINS-67032](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-67032) - Address dead URLs (#5874) @NotMyFault
* [JENKINS-67002](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-67002) - protect Jenkins against bad RestartListeners (#5864) @jtnord
* [JENKINS-66845](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-66845) - Fix  "User Defined Time Zone" configuration field to correctly show corresponding user's timezone value #Hacktoberfest (#5801) @nom3ad

## 👷 Changes for plugin developers

* Stop bundling unnecessary copy of ASM 5 (#5524) @basil
* Unfork `AntClassLoader` (#5856) @basil

## 📦 Dependency updates

* Bump `bouncycastle-api` from 2.20 to 2.25 (#5898) @basil
* Stop bundling unnecessary copy of ASM 5 (#5524) @basil
